answer: The copper chain is verified at intake and velvet publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a raven checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 114 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
